testcase: MB-75515: plan stability PREPARED_ONLY, error policy STRICT
statements: UPDATE system:settings SET plan_stability.mode = "prepared only", plan_stability.error_policy = "strict"

testcase: MB-75515: an index for the subquery of the UDF
statements: CREATE INDEX mb75515_idx ON shellTest(c21) WHERE type = "right"

testcase: MB-75515: an inline UDF with a subquery
statements: CREATE FUNCTION UDF_PlanStability_inline6(x) { ( SELECT RAW r.c21 FROM shellTest r USE INDEX (mb75515_idx) WHERE r.type = "right" AND r.c21 > x ORDER BY r.c21 ) }

testcase: MB-75515: execute it, its entry is saved
statements: EXECUTE FUNCTION UDF_PlanStability_inline6(6)

testcase: MB-75515: back up its saved entry
statements: INSERT INTO QUERY_METADATA._system._query (KEY "mb75515_backup", VALUE {"origId": origId, "doc": doc}) SELECT meta(d).id AS origId, d AS doc FROM QUERY_METADATA._system._query AS d WHERE meta(d).id LIKE 'ppn::%' AND d.inlineUDF = true AND d.name LIKE '%UDF_PlanStability_inline6'

testcase: MB-75515: replace the UDF (same body): its entry is removed, and the UDF reloaded
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION UDF_PlanStability_inline6(x) { ( SELECT RAW r.c21 FROM shellTest r USE INDEX (mb75515_idx) WHERE r.type = "right" AND r.c21 > x ORDER BY r.c21 ) }

testcase: MB-75515: put the saved entry back
statements: UPSERT INTO QUERY_METADATA._system._query (KEY origId, VALUE doc) SELECT b.origId, b.doc FROM QUERY_METADATA._system._query AS b USE KEYS "mb75515_backup"

testcase: MB-75515: execute the UDF with its saved entry
statements: EXECUTE FUNCTION UDF_PlanStability_inline6(6)

testcase: MB-75515: remove the entry
statements: DELETE FROM system:prepareds WHERE name LIKE "__INLINE_UDF__%UDF_PlanStability_inline6"

testcase: MB-75515: the UDF still executes
statements: EXECUTE FUNCTION UDF_PlanStability_inline6(6)

testcase: MB-75515: and its entry is saved again
statements: SELECT RAW COUNT(*) FROM QUERY_METADATA._system._query AS d WHERE meta(d).id LIKE 'ppn::%' AND d.inlineUDF = true AND d.name LIKE '%UDF_PlanStability_inline6'

testcase: MB-75515: replace the UDF again
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION UDF_PlanStability_inline6(x) { ( SELECT RAW r.c21 FROM shellTest r USE INDEX (mb75515_idx) WHERE r.type = "right" AND r.c21 > x ORDER BY r.c21 ) }

testcase: MB-75515: put the saved entry back again
statements: UPSERT INTO QUERY_METADATA._system._query (KEY origId, VALUE doc) SELECT b.origId, b.doc FROM QUERY_METADATA._system._query AS b USE KEYS "mb75515_backup"

testcase: MB-75515: drop the index of the saved plan
statements: DROP INDEX shellTest.mb75515_idx

testcase: MB-75515: the saved plan can not be used, STRICT: error (4001, in a function execution error)
statements: EXECUTE FUNCTION UDF_PlanStability_inline6(6)

testcase: MB-75515: drop the UDF
statements: DROP FUNCTION UDF_PlanStability_inline6

testcase: MB-75515: its entry is removed
statements: SELECT RAW COUNT(*) FROM QUERY_METADATA._system._query AS d WHERE meta(d).id LIKE 'ppn::%' AND d.inlineUDF = true AND d.name LIKE '%UDF_PlanStability_inline6'

testcase: MB-75515: an inline UDF without subquery
statements: CREATE FUNCTION UDF_PlanStability_inline7(x) { x + 1 }

testcase: MB-75515: execute it
statements: EXECUTE FUNCTION UDF_PlanStability_inline7(6)

testcase: MB-75515: it has no entry
statements: SELECT RAW COUNT(*) FROM QUERY_METADATA._system._query AS d WHERE meta(d).id LIKE 'ppn::%' AND d.name LIKE '%UDF_PlanStability_inline7'

testcase: MB-75515: drop it
statements: DROP FUNCTION UDF_PlanStability_inline7

testcase: MB-75515: a prepared statement can not take the name of an inline UDF entry
statements: PREPARE `__INLINE_UDF__default:UDF_PlanStability_inline7` FROM SELECT 1

testcase: MB-75515: remove the backup
statements: DELETE FROM QUERY_METADATA._system._query USE KEYS "mb75515_backup"

testcase: MB-75515: plan stability off
statements: UPDATE system:settings UNSET plan_stability
